decision.rationale: Date × Category is the primary forecasting grain. Every category has sales on every calendar day in 2024 (zero sparsity), with at least 16 invoices per cell. Date × City × Category is more granular for local replenishment but is sparser (328 empty city-category-days, median 4 invoices) and noisier for daily revenue. City, brand, channel, and store-format views are produced by top-down allocation of category forecasts using trailing 30-day revenue shares. Assumption: recent mix is a reasonable allocator when the model is not trained at that grain.
